    input_dir = "./input"
    submission_dir = "./submission"

    train_path = f"{input_dir}/train.csv"
    test_path = f"{input_dir}/test.csv"
    sample_sub_path = f"{input_dir}/sample_submission.csv"
    sub_path = f"{submission_dir}/submission.csv"

    # Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
    os.makedirs(submission_dir, exist_ok=True)

    # Load data
    train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
    test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)
    sample_sub = pd.read_csv(sample_sub_path)

    # Get submission template from sample
    submission_cols = sample_sub.columns.tolist()
    assert "id" in submission_cols and "target" in submission_cols

    # Identify categorical features from data overview: f_27 is object type, others are numeric
    # Check which columns are actually categorical
    cat_cols = []
    for col in train_df.columns:
        if col == "id" or col == "target":
            continue
        if train_df[col].dtype == "object":
            cat_cols.append(col)

    print(f"Categorical columns detected: {cat_cols}")

    # Prepare training and testing datasets with proper categorical conversion
    X_train = train_df[
        [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["id", "target"]]
    ].copy()
    y_train = train_df["target"].values.astype(float)
    X_test = test_df[
        [col for col in test_df.columns if col not in ["id", "target"]]
    ].copy()

    # Convert categorical columns to category dtype before training
    for col in cat_cols:
        X_train[col] = X_train[col].astype("category")
        X_test[col] = X_test[col].astype("category")

    feature_cols = list(X_train.columns)

    # True hold-out validation split (80/20)

        X_train.copy(), y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
    )

    # Re-split again for final model to not include val rows (true hold-out)
    X_final_train, X_holdout, y_final_train, y_holdout = train_test_split(
        X_train.values, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
    )

    # LightGBM parameters
    params = {
        "objective": "binary",
        "metric": "auc",
        "verbose": -1,
        "num_leaves": 31,
        "min_child_samples": 50,
        "learning_rate": 0.05,
        "seed": 42,
        "force_col_wise": False,
    }

    # Convert numerical features to float64 for consistency
    X_final_train = pd.DataFrame(X_final_train, columns=feature_cols)
    X_train_for_model = X_train.drop(columns=["id"]).reset_index(drop=True)
    X_test_for_model = X_test.drop(columns=["id"]).reset_index(drop=True)

    # Create datasets with categorical info
    cat_feature_list = []
    for col in cat_cols:
        cat_feature_list.append(feature_cols.index(col))

    if len(cat_feature_list) > 0:
        params["categorical_feature"] = cat_feature_list

    # Train on final training data only (true hold-out validation)
    train_set = lgb.Dataset(
        X_final_train, label=y_final_train, feature_name=feature_cols
    )
